handbookNote: North Carolina General Statutes Chapter 10B (Notary Public Act) -- batch 2 depth expansion, NOT a fresh build: batch 1 already loaded 131 questions live in D1 across General Provisions & Commissioning, Notarial Acts/Powers/Limitations & Fees, Signature/Seal & Certificate Forms, Changes in Status/Enforcement & Validation, and Electronic & Remote Notarization. Batch 2 adds new, non-overlapping content grounded in the same Chapter 10B text (source already compiled at temp/handbooks/nc/notary.txt, confirmed complete against ncleg.gov structure through Article 3), targeting statutory areas batch 1 left thin or untested: (1) G.S. 10B-25 Emergency Video Notarization, a fully untested ~14-subsection section covering video-conference-technology standards, the stricter EVN 'satisfactory evidence' standard, same-day wet-signed-original procedures, required certificate statement language, and journal mechanics; (2) Article 3 Video Witnessing During a State of Emergency (G.S. 10B-200/10B-201), entirely untested in batch 1; (3) remaining G.S. 10B-3 definitions (attest, commission, jurat, moral turpitude, notarial act/certificate, notary-as-public-officer, personal appearance, record, regular place of work, subscribing witness, suspension/restriction, verification-proof subparts); (4) Part 4A Remote Electronic Notarization depth -- untested G.S. 10B-134.1 definitions (communication technology, credential analysis, custodian/depository, geolocation, identity proofing, self-attestation, tamper-evident) plus deeper procedural/security/liability provisions in 10B-134.3, .5, .7, .9, .11, .13, .15, .17, .19, and .23 that batch 1 only touched at the surface; (5) the validation and curative provisions of G.S. 10B-65 through 10B-73 and 10B-99(b), which batch 1 tested only once; and (6) genuinely new scenario/application fact patterns (trustee-exception, bank-employee-shareholder, fee-exception professions, EVN identity-standard comparisons, RON document-type and POA-combination prohibitions, judicial remote-oath exception, journal confidentiality/public-records status) applying already-tested core rules to new facts rather than restating batch-1 clauses, plus remaining commissioning/certificate nuances (10B-40(a1)-(a3)/(h) implied certifications, 10B-12 declaration text, 10B-53 combined name+county change, 10B-21(c)-(e) ex officio Director/fee/scope rules). Every question cites a specific G.S. 10B section with no invented facts; the build script's dedup pass additionally confirmed 0 near-duplicates within this batch. This depth of genuinely distinct, well-grounded content confirms G.S. Chapter 10B can support the combined 131 (batch 1) + 106 (batch 2) = 237 questions without padding -- within this project's established 200-250 floor for real-exam notary states. Same $9.99 self-serve price tier as batch 1 and as the rest of this project's notary tracks -- not a placeholder.
